confidence_config:
# Prespecified hypotheses; do not tune on held-out scenes.
error_scale_px: 1.0
angle_scale_deg: 1.0
support_target: 4
reprojection_threshold_px: 0.5
angle_threshold_deg: 0.3
score_threshold: 0.65
min_observations: 3
combined_weights: [0.6, 0.4]
multiview_weights: [0.45, 0.35, 0.2]
